sql:
/*
================================================================================
项目：蜡笔小新繁体 CBT 首日留存与新加坡全量成熟基准
口径：
  - 繁体：2026-07-29 创角账号；R1 为 2026-07-30 当日实时临时值。
  - 新加坡：2026-05-08 fixed_country=新加坡的全量创角账号；R1/R3/R7/R14/R30 已成熟。
  - 留存为注册后第 N 个自然日发生 login 的去重账号占 cohort 的比例。
================================================================================
*/

WITH Days(day_n) AS (
    VALUES 0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 30
),
TC_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Singapore AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_country' AND tag_value = '新加坡'
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT
        '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS cohort_date,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND v."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '新加坡全量' AS cohort_name,
        DATE '2026-05-08' AS cohort_date,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_13 v
    INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-05-08'
      AND v."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
LoginDays AS (
    SELECT
        '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        CAST(v."$part_date" AS DATE) AS login_date
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'login'
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-30'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '新加坡全量' AS cohort_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        CAST(v."$part_date" AS DATE) AS login_date
    FROM ta.v_event_13 v
    INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'login'
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND '2026-06-07'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
CohortSize AS (
    SELECT cohort_name, cohort_date, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS cohort_users
    FROM CohortUsers
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
Retention AS (
    SELECT
        c.cohort_name,
        c.cohort_date,
        d.day_n,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.account_id) AS cohort_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN d.day_n = 0 THEN c.account_id
            WHEN l.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.account_id
        END) AS retained_users
    FROM CohortUsers c
    CROSS JOIN Days d
    LEFT JOIN LoginDays l
      ON c.cohort_name = l.cohort_name
     AND c.account_id = l.account_id
     AND l.login_date = DATE_ADD('day', d.day_n, c.cohort_date)
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT
    r.cohort_name AS "用户组",
    CAST(r.cohort_date AS VARCHAR) AS "创角日期",
    CONCAT('R', CAST(r.day_n AS VARCHAR)) AS "留存日",
    r.cohort_users AS "创角人数",
    CASE
        WHEN r.cohort_name = '繁体CBT' AND r.day_n > 1 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
        ELSE r.retained_users
    END AS "留存人数",
    CASE
        WHEN r.cohort_name = '繁体CBT' AND r.day_n > 1 THEN CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)
        ELSE ROUND(100.0 * r.retained_users / NULLIF(r.cohort_users, 0), 2)
    END AS "留存率(%)",
    CASE
        WHEN r.cohort_name = '繁体CBT'
         AND r.day_n = 1
         AND CURRENT_DATE <= DATE_ADD('day', 1, r.cohort_date)
            THEN '临时值：次日自然日未结束'
        WHEN r.cohort_name = '繁体CBT' AND r.day_n > 1 THEN '未成熟'
        ELSE '已成熟'
    END AS "成熟状态",
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS VARCHAR) AS "刷新时间"
FROM Retention r
ORDER BY r.cohort_name, r.day_n;
